post.text: Is Telugu going to be on the iPhone app too, or only the web app at first?

log.text: Is Telugu going to be on the iPhone app too, or only the web app at first?

:robot_face: Hi Lakshmi, I'm *Manish's AI Peer*, an AI assistant that covers for Manish. Manish is offline right now (it's 4:38 PM in India), so here is what Manish's work records say:

Good question, Lakshmi. *It isn't decided yet.* "Which apps first" is still an open call for Manish in the Telugu design, and he hasn't been asked it yet.

What the records show:
• The plan includes iPhone work (WP5a/5b: TestFlight first, then the App Store), after the web and Android packages (WP4a/4b).
• The design suggests *web and Android first if the pilot phones are Android, with iPhone right after through TestFlight*. The other options are all three at once, or iPhone too through TestFlight.
• Launching without iPhone needs Manish's explicit OK.
• No dates are set yet. The build is at the profile-settings stage (WP2b).

If you know which phones the pilot schools use, that would help Manish decide. He'll confirm.
